sources.title: GitHub - TontonTremblay/blender2rand
sources.snippet: Overview This pipeline takes .blend files containing animated Jaco robot picking motions (generated in a physics simulator) and renders them with aggressive visual domain randomization for sim-to-real transfer. The motion is never modified — only the visual appearance changes.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Turn any photo or text prompt into a 3D model with local AI. Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY. Free, open source, runs entirely on your GPU — no cloud, no account.
